Grain Monitoring System Pricing

CentaurOne makes advanced AI grain monitoring practical and affordable for smaller farm grain bins. Our system combines wireless Arrow sensor technology, CFD Digital Twin modeling, Chiron AI grain condition monitoring, and remote fan control in one integrated solution. With straightforward hardware pricing and an annual monitoring subscription, farmers can protect their stored grain without the expense and complexity of traditional multi-sensor monitoring systems.

Standard System Pricing

First bin equipment and setup: $2,695 per site.

Additional bin equipment and setup: $1,095 per bin at the same site.

Annual AI monitoring: $795 per bin per year.

Additional Arrow sensor: $995 each.

Custom configurations and larger storage facilities require a quote.
